newsitem.title: USA: North Dakota to sell $17.8 mln of bonds in October.
newsitem.headline: North Dakota to sell $17.8 mln of bonds in October.

text.p: North Dakota plans to sell $17.8 million of revenue bonds in October to finance building projects on university campuses, the state budget director said Tuesday.

The borrowing approved during the last legislative session will finance buildings at North Dakota State, the University of North Dakota and smaller projects at other campuses, said Rod Backman, director of the office of management and budget.

North Dakota has not decided whether the sale will be negotiated or competitive or set a specific date, Backman said. Evensen Dodge Inc has been selected as financial adviser and Bismarck attorney Maurice Cook will serve as bond counsel, he said.
